subject: Quantitative Ability
q: A retailer charges Rs 7,980 for a jacket and makes 40% profit. How much did the jacket cost the retailer?
explanation: SP = 140% of CP, so CP = 7,980 × 100/140 = Rs 5,700 (the percentage is on the cost, not on the selling price).

q: A property dealer sold a house for Rs 252 lakh, making a profit of 40%. What had the house cost him?
explanation: SP = 140% of CP, so CP = 252 × 100/140 = Rs 180 (the percentage is on the cost, not on the selling price).
